plan_item: P5-3 PT-SOAK-02: a long run leaks nothing and keeps its deadlines
what: The full MOCK worker pipeline (API, workers, fake Sales, PostgreSQL) run for the requested time, sampled at a fixed interval, judged by comparing the first quarter of the samples with the last.

criteria.name: api: one process for the whole run
criteria.limit: one pid, present in every sample

criteria.name: worker-1: one process for the whole run
criteria.limit: one pid, present in every sample

criteria.name: worker-2: one process for the whole run
criteria.limit: one pid, present in every sample

criteria.name: no task outlives its window
criteria.limit: no task still without a final result 60 s after its window closed, in any sample

criteria.name: no dial after a window closed
criteria.limit: no attempt started after its task's window closed

criteria.name: no customer outcome after a window closed
criteria.limit: every result other than IVR_CONFIRMATION_WINDOW_EXPIRED lands before its window closes

criteria.name: expired windows are closed promptly
criteria.limit: every expired window closed within 60 s; last-quarter median lag <= first-quarter median + 30 s

criteria.name: deadline slack does not erode
criteria.limit: customer outcomes: last-quarter median slack >= first-quarter median - 30 s

criteria.name: rounds
criteria.limit: every round settles with the outcome its scenario specifies

not_claimed: The limits are this harness's own, chosen to tell growth without bound from settling after warm-up. None of them is an approved service level.
No latency figure for D-04: with a fake provider the time measured is the fake's.
MOCK only: no SIM, no carrier, no real customer. Capacity on 32 real channels is W-0008.
One machine and one database, with the API and workers as local processes rather than in the cluster.
